publicCopy.titleZh: 苏格兰要求新建超过 50MW 的数据中心申请纳入环境影响评估
publicCopy.titleEn: Scotland requires environmental impact assessment for new data-centre applications above 50MW
publicCopy.summaryZh: 新指令自 9 月 17 日起适用于总拟用电容量超过 50MW 的新建数据中心；它不是暂停令或项目批准。
publicCopy.summaryEn: The Direction applies from September 17 to new data centres with more than 50MW of total proposed electrical power; it is not a moratorium or project approval.

publicClaims.claim: The Direction requires EIA treatment for qualifying new data-centre developments above 50MW of total proposed electrical power from September 17, 2026.
publicClaims.qualifier: new development above 50MW total proposed electrical power
